Set up Pushover

  1. Create a Pushover application named MMHotline. Create the application

  2. Put the MMHotline application's API token in the settings file, as shown below, and apply the settings file. MMHotline checks the token and the current month's message limit with Pushover before saving the token.

  3. Each person adds a personal Pushover user key under Contact methods. Saving the Pushover contact method sends a quiet test notification.

Settings file keys

  • Pushover application token

    sending_services.pushover.application_token

    The API token of your team's MMHotline application. A new token replaces the current application token and keeps every Pushover contact method.

Example settings

sending_services:
  pushover:
    application_token: <Pushover application token>
Where Pushover is set up

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in sending_services.pushover. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
